description: This file defines a set of React components for implementing a customizable select dropdown using the @radix-ui/react-select primitive and lucide-react icons. It includes components for the select itself, its groupings, trigger, content, items, labels, separators, scroll buttons, and value display, all styled with utility classes and composed via React functional components.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Main wrapper for the select component, rendering a radix select root.

methods.name: SelectGroup
methods.description: Component for grouping related select items.

methods.name: SelectValue
methods.description: Displays the selected value of the select component.

methods.name: SelectTrigger
methods.description: The button that triggers the dropdown open/close behavior.

methods.name: SelectContent
methods.description: Renders the dropdown content, including viewport and scroll controls.

methods.name: SelectLabel
methods.description: Label for grouping or sections within the select menu.

methods.name: SelectItem
methods.description: An individual selectable item within the dropdown.

methods.name: SelectScrollUpButton
methods.description: Button to scroll up the dropdown list.

methods.name: SelectScrollDownButton
methods.description: Button to scroll down the dropdown list.
